SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Nurse Gyu-ri! Do you have a dog at home, by any chance?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah... then this might be a bit of a problem.

SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: É que eu sou alérgico a pelo de cachorro.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Well then! You should head on home. I’ll see you around!
